content:
为什么不能在每次出牌前看到这张卡牌未来可能造成的伤害？你毕竟是一个卡牌游戏，伤害总要靠玩家自己猜，有什么意义？卡牌游戏的快乐不就是合理的分配资源用恰到好处的伤害杀死怪物吗？我不想再赌“我能杀了它”，结果就差一点点伤害需要重开了！
"Why can't I see the potential damage this card will deal before I actually play it? After all, this is a card game—why should players have to guess the damage output? What's the point? Isn't the fun of card games about wisely allocating resources and dealing just the right amount of damage to finish off a monster? I don't want to keep gambling on 'I can kill it,' only to miss by a tiny bit of damage and have to restart the whole fight!"
